ROTARY CLUB OF MUMBAI MULUND EAST PROJECT REPORT AWARENESS ON LEGAL REMEDIES FOR WOMEN

Date: 18 October 2026 (Sunday)
Occasion: 8th Day of Navratri
Time: 11:00 AM onwards
Venue: Rotary Centre, Mulund East
Project cost Rs 1000

Project Description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Mulund East organised an awareness session on Legal Remedies for Women on the auspicious occasion of the 8th day of Navratri.

Advocate Rtn. Sadhana shared valuable information on women’s legal rights, available support systems, and legal remedies. The session was highly interactive, with meaningful discussions and active participation from the women present.

Beneficiaries: 10 women

Members Attended:

* President Rtn. Suyash Tripathi
* Advocate Rtn. Sadhana
* Rtn. Avinash

Outcome: The session empowered women with greater awareness of their legal rights and encouraged them to seek appropriate support when needed.
